template.name: IMACD Sniper
template.entry_long: crossabove(macd(close,{p0},{p1}),macd_signal(close,{p2},26,9)) and close > ema(close,20) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > {p0} and close - open > {p1} * atr(high,low,close,14)
template.notes: MACD 12/26/9, EMA(20), volume above average, and a 0.5-ATR bullish body retain the documented core; zero-distance normalization is omitted. Dynamic 4.0/1.5 ATR targets and stops are not percentage fields.
